verdict.rationale: DBOS documents running workflows on a cron schedule. Those schedules are stored in the database and can be created, paused, resumed, and deleted at runtime (dbos-docs-7). Schedules can also be managed programmatically through the Conductor HTTP API and the dbosctl CLI, which suits scripted, AI-native workflows (dbos-docs-17, dbos-docs-32, dbos-docs-33). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the scheduling feature, since all evidence is first-party documentation.
